headline: Android TV IPTV player (M3U)
summary: Android TV app that plays M3U/M3U8 playlists with Media3/ExoPlayer (HLS, TS, DASH). Ships with iptv-org free-to-air sources built in — UK (319), Denmark (153), US (1579), Sports (502) — plus 'Add playlist URL' for your own provider. D-pad UI: source tiles, group filters, search, channel list with lo
